intent.tagline: The habit-hooks scan reports 2,456 findings. This program names them in one catalog, clears the viewer-shell cluster, and hands the next cluster to a program that follows.
intent.narration: ADR-0038 made the habit-hooks scan a standing check that review and maintenance run. A standing check that only reports never resolves. The scan now holds 2,456 findings across 14 smells, and the repo has a way to read them but no record of what they mean or who will fix them. This program closes that gap. It writes one catalog that clusters the findings and gives each cluster a verdict, it clears the one cluster a bounded program can take, the viewer shell, and it ends by commissioning the next cluster so the work does not stop at one design.

problem_solution.problem: The standing scan reports 2,456 findings across 14 smells, and none is resolved or named for the next person to take. The viewer shell holds 346 of them in about 40 files that top every limit at once.
problem_solution.solution: One catalog clusters the findings and gives each cluster a verdict. The program clears the viewer-shell structural cluster by area, logic first, and ends by commissioning the next cluster as its own program.
problem_solution.narration: The catalog is the first thing that turns the scan into work. It lists all 14 smells with their counts, it groups them into six clusters, and it gives each cluster a verdict: resolve now, commission next, or defer with a named owner. The six clusters are structural, type surface, hygiene, duplicates, Python exceptions, and comment habit. Only the structural cluster is in scope, and of that only the viewer shell, because it is one district and one program can finish it. The program clears the shell by area, not by smell. It starts with the logic layer, model.ts and bundle.ts, because pure logic proves a split keeps behavior with the test suite alone. Then the atoms and sections, the change surface, and the top-level shell. Each epic keeps the export names and re-exports the moved units, so the tests that import the old names still pass. The scan itself is the verifier: a shell file is done when habit-sensors reports no finding for it. The last epic does not stop. It decides the next cluster, the type surface, and authors its program, type-surface-sweep, and marks the catalog row so the next design opens that cluster by name.

beats.text: A standing check that reports 2,456 findings but names none of them leaves the next engineer to re-run the scan and re-judge every cluster.
ADR-0016 keeps the plugins as a bundle seam, so a bounded program stays inside one district, the viewer under plugins/artifact/viewer/.
The shell's public surface, its model, atom, section, and hook exports, is the contract the tests and the other files import.
Split by area, logic first. The logic layer proves the export-stability contract and the byte-equal rebuild guard before a render epic depends on them.
The 12-line function limit is a recorded exception. A 13-to-30-line component that is one render unit may stay, and the catalog names the decision.
The last epic commissions the next cluster. It authors type-surface-sweep and marks its catalog row, so the standing scan becomes work the next program takes by name.
A split that moves an export breaks the tests that import it. The abort condition that a split must change an export name guards the whole program.

alternatives.option: Tune the sensor card for the viewer instead of refactoring to the limits
alternatives.rejected_because: It hides the debt behind a higher limit and leaves 1,560-line files. ADR-0023 set the component model to make the shell small.

alternatives.option: Split by smell, one epic per smell across the whole repo
alternatives.rejected_because: It reopens each of the 40 files seven times and mixes the shell with the Python scripts. By-area keeps one surface stable in one epic.

alternatives.option: Refactor the whole repo's structural findings now, Python and cobuilder-memory included
alternatives.rejected_because: It widens the blast radius to 105 files across three plugin families, which ADR-0016's seam keeps separate.

alternatives.option: Resolve every cluster now, including the 1,283 comment findings
alternatives.rejected_because: The comment count is a habit about density, and ADR-0004 values explanation. Deleting it on a scan verdict is not safe.

architecture.narration: The split runs in one order, by area. The logic layer comes first, then the atoms and sections, then the change surface, then the top-level shell and chrome. Each step is smaller than the last, and each one keeps the export surface it touches. A unit that moves from a large file into a new one is re-exported under its old name, so an import of that name still resolves and the test that drives it still runs. The habit-hooks scan is the standing verifier across every step: after a step, the engineer re-runs habit-sensors on the files the step touched, and a file is done when the scan reports no finding for it. The catalog is the memory between steps. It holds the counts, the clusters, and the verdicts, and it is the one place a later design reads to take a deferred cluster. The last step is different from the rest. It does not clear a file. It opens the catalog's deferred clusters, picks the type surface as the next program, and writes that program's goal.json, so the chain of programs continues past this one.

beats.text: findings-catalog.md under docs/architecture/designs/mechanical-smells/: the scan, the 14 smells with counts, the six clusters, and a verdict per cluster.
The viewer logic layer: model.ts and bundle.ts, split by concern, exports kept stable, verified by the vitest suite.
The render layers: atoms.tsx, sections.tsx, panels, the change surface, and the top-level shell, each split by render unit.
The export surface of model.ts, atoms.tsx, sections.tsx, and App.tsx is the contract. A split keeps every name and re-exports the moved unit.
habit-sensors is the standing verifier. A shell file is done when the scan reports no finding for it.
After the logic epics, a byte-identical rebuild of the committed index.html holds, so a logic split changed no output.
The last epic authors type-surface-sweep/goal.json and marks its catalog row commissioned, so the next program opens by name.
